title: YouCoded — sign-off: final icon, final installer, logo set with the final icon

steps.headline: Is this the final app icon?
steps.changed: R1 with each theme's own eyes and the thin theme-coloured rim (your pick C).
steps.notice: It re-dresses itself in every theme, as the app already does with its icon.
steps.risk: The rim is drawn in each theme's deep colour, so the outline colour changes per theme.

steps.headline: Is this the final installer icon?
steps.changed: U1 with your notes: face a little lower, streaks spread wider and a touch shorter.
steps.notice: It matches the app icon's glass and face, so download and app read as one family.
steps.risk: At 16px the box and streaks merge; the face still carries it.

steps.headline: Do the lockups still work with the final icon?
steps.changed: Your approved L1, redrawn with the final icon in place of the stand-in.
steps.notice: Nothing else changed from what you approved.
steps.risk: The "yc" tile (bottom right) is still the older wallpaper style; say if it should match the final white-glass icon.

steps.headline: Do the colour versions still work with the final icon?
steps.changed: Your approved L2 with the final icon, including its theme versions.

steps.headline: Does the set in use still work with the final icon?
steps.changed: Your approved L4 with the final icon on the header, title bar, tab and footer.
steps.risk: The title-bar icon is 18px, where the rim and eyes are at their smallest.
